# 智能合约审计与形式化验证流水线

## 用途

合约产物与 ABI 管理、静态规则与模式库、符号执行与模糊测试编排、不变式检查、缺陷归因与报告版本化。

本仓库是可持续演进的自托管 Go 应用。领域核心位于 `contractsentinel/`，命令入口位于 `cmd/contractsentinel/`。

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel demo
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel version
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel resolve <config-file> < request.json
go test ./...
```

## 离线路由解析（resolve）

`resolve` 从配置文件读取路由，从标准输入读取一个 JSON 请求，在本机离线
完成匹配并输出命中的路由与上游地址，全程不建立网络连接。

配置文件：

```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"id": "api",  "methods": ["GET"], "pathPrefix": "/api", "upstream": "http://api.internal/v1"},
    {"id": "root", "methods": ["*"],  "pathPrefix": "/",    "upstream": "https://fallback.internal/base/"}
  ]
}
```

请求（`target` 为带可选查询串的路径）：

```json
{"method": "GET", "target": "/api/orders/7?a=1&a="}
```

成功时标准输出：

```json
{"routeId":"api","upstreamURL":"http://api.internal/v1/orders/7?a=1&a="}
```

匹配规则：

- `methods` 为非空数组，元素是区分大小写的具体 HTTP 方法名或 `*`（匹配任意合法方法）。
- `pathPrefix` 以 `/` 开头，除根前缀 `/` 外不能以 `/` 结尾，不含查询串或片段。
- 前缀按原始编码与请求路径匹配，并必须落在路径段边界上：`/api` 匹配
  `/api` 与 `/api/orders`，不匹配 `/apiv2`；`%2F` 不视为分隔符。
- 查询串不参与匹配。多条命中时最长前缀优先；前缀相同则具体方法优先于 `*`；
  仍有多条候选时返回 `route_conflict`，候选 `id` 按字典序排列；无候选返回
  `route_not_found`。
- 命中后去掉请求路径前缀，剩余路径接到 upstream 基础路径之后，连接处恰好
  保留一个 `/`（剩余路径为空也保留）；根前缀 `/` 保留其后全部路径。连接处
  以外的路径、百分号编码与原始查询串（含重复参数、空值与顺序）逐字节保留。

### queryTransforms 查询串改写

每条路由可新增 `queryTransforms` 数组，在路由选定之后、路径拼接完成后按
数组顺序改写查询串；匹配、冲突判定与路径拼接均不受其影响。省略该字段或给
空数组时，原始查询串逐字节保留。规则形如：

```json
"queryTransforms": [
  {"op": "set",    "name": "a",    "value": ""},
  {"op": "remove", "name": "flag"},
  {"op": "rename", "name": "old",  "to": "new"}
]
```

- `op` 仅支持 `set`、`remove`、`rename`；`name` 为非空字符串，按字面值使用。
- `set` 必须提供字符串 `value`（允许空字符串）；`remove` 不接受 `value`。
- `rename` 必须提供非空字符串 `to`，不接受 `value`；`name` 与 `to` 按
  字面值使用。命中的参数在原位置改名，各自的值、数量与相对顺序保留；
  已经叫目标名的参数继续保留，不合并也不覆盖。无等号的参数改名后仍无
  等号，空值保留等号；只重新编码被改动参数的名称（编码方式与 `set`
  相同），等号及其后的内容逐字节保留，值中的 `+`、百分号转义、额外等号
  与大小写都不改写。例如 `old=1&new=9&%6Fld=%2f+&old&x=` 把 `old`
  改名为 `new` 后得到 `new=1&new=9&new=%2f+&new&x=`。没有来源参数时
  查询串完全不变；`name` 与 `to` 相同时也不改写已有的名称编码。
- 查询串只以 `&` 分隔，第一个 `=` 分开名称和值；没有 `=` 的片段也能按名称
  命中。空查询串（`?` 后为空）视为没有片段，其余空片段（如 `?a=1&` 末尾）
  保留且不作为参数。
- 比较参数名称时解码百分号转义、把 `+` 视为空格、区分大小写，不做其他
  归一化；未命中名称的参数与其原始内容、顺序保持不变。
- `remove` 删除该名称的全部参数。`set` 把该名称的全部参数合并为一个，
  放在首次命中的位置；原查询中不存在时追加到末尾。没有查询串时 `remove`
  不产生问号，`set` 会创建查询串；原先的空问号在没有实际修改时保留，
  删除命中参数后若参数与空片段均已清空则去掉问号。
- 新增或替换的参数写成编码后的 `name=value`：仅 ASCII 字母、数字及
  `-._~` 原样出现，其他 UTF-8 字节使用大写百分号转义，空格写为 `%20`。
- 后一条规则基于前一条规则的结果执行。例如查询串
  `x=%2f&a=1&%61=2&flag` 先 `set a=""` 再 `remove flag`，结果为
  `x=%2f&a=`。`rename` 同样按数组次序串接：后续对目标名的 `set`
  仍合并所有同名参数，`remove` 仍删除全部同名参数。

数组或规则为 `null`、字段类型错误、未知操作、空名称、缺少必要字段、
`remove` 带 `value` 或 `rename` 缺少/带非法 `to` 或带 `value`，都使
整个配置返回 `invalid_config`（即使出错路由不会被命中）；reason 定位到
路由，规则错误另给出从 1 开始的规则序号。

失败时标准错误输出含 `code`、`reason` 的 JSON（`route_conflict` 另含
`candidates`），退出状态非零，标准输出不留下结果：

- `invalid_config`：配置不可读、JSON 无效或任一路由不合法（含非法
  queryTransforms；能定位时指出第几条路由及 id，规则错误指出规则序号）。
  合法 JSON 但结构不符与语法损坏严格区分：最外层必须是 JSON 对象，
  数组、字符串、数字、布尔值和 null 都被拒绝，reason 说明配置必须是
  对象并指出实际收到的类型，不猜测路由序号；对象中只要提供 `routes`
  就必须是数组，其他类型（含 null）报 `routes` 类型错误，不能当成没有
  路由；没有 `routes` 键的对象与 `"routes": []` 仍是合法空路由配置，
  合法请求对其解析得到 `route_not_found`。`routes` 数组的每个元素必须
  是对象，null 也按元素类型错误处理（不报缺少 id），reason 指出从 1
  开始的路由序号、要求的对象类型和实际收到的类型，且即使请求只会命中
  较早的合法路由，后面的非对象元素也会使整份配置被拒绝。
  合法 JSON 中某条路由的 `id`、`methods`、`pathPrefix`、`upstream`
  字段类型本身不符（如 `methods` 写成字符串、数组元素不是字符串）时，
  reason 直接指出从 1 开始的路由序号与字段，而非把整份配置说成无效
  JSON；该路由同时提供了合法非空字符串 `id` 时附带该 id（即使它写在
  出错字段之后），但 `id` 自身类型错误时只报位置与字段。只有 JSON
  语法损坏才报解析失败（即使开头包含 `routes` 或完整的第一条路由），
  且不猜测出错字段或路由位置；配置结构错误与请求错误同时存在时先报告
  `invalid_config`。此外，`upstream` 用方括号包围主机时，括号内必须是合法
  IPv6 地址（完整写法、压缩写法、含 IPv4 尾段均可），允许带端口、用户信息
  与区域标识（`%25eth0`）；空括号、括号内为普通名称或 IPv4 地址（如
  `[not-an-ip]`、`[127.0.0.1]`）及格式错误的 IPv6 地址都使整份配置返回
  `invalid_config`，reason 指出从 1 开始的路由序号、id 与 `upstream` 字段，
  说明括号中的主机不是合法 IPv6 地址，而不是把配置 JSON 说成语法损坏；普通
  域名与不带方括号的 IPv4 主机不受影响。反过来，IPv6 字面量主机必须完整放
  在一对方括号内，端口写在括号之外（如 `http://[2001:db8::1]:8080/base`）：
  完整写法、压缩写法、含 IPv4 尾段及带 `%25eth0` 区域标识的地址，不加括号都
  被拒绝，`http://2001:db8::1/base`、`http://::1:8080/base` 与
  `http://::ffff:192.0.2.1/base` 均属此类，末尾是数字也不能使其成为合法配置
  （主机与端口边界有歧义时不猜测端口，也不自动补括号），带端口或用户信息的
  写法同样拒绝；reason 指出从 1 开始的路由序号、该路由 id 与 `upstream` 字段，
  说明 IPv6 主机缺少方括号，这是地址内容错误而非配置 JSON 语法损坏，且只检查
  主机段——用户信息或基础路径中出现冒号不影响判定。此外，每个上游都必须真正
  填写非空主机：`http://:8080/base`、`https://:8443`、`http://:/base` 都使
  整份配置返回 `invalid_config`，即使主机位置前带有用户名或密码（如
  `https://user:p%40ss@:8443/v1`）也相同——用户信息、端口和基础路径都不能
  补足缺失的主机，也不会补上任何默认地址；判断的是主机有没有填写，端口格式
  仍沿用现有规则，所以有主机的 `http://api.internal:/base`（空端口）继续按
  现有行为接受。reason 指出从 1 开始的路由序号、该路由 id 与 `upstream`
  字段，并说明上游缺少主机，既不能说成配置 JSON 解析失败，也不能说成 IPv6
  缺少方括号；配置中只要有一条路由存在此问题，即使当前请求只会命中较早的
  合法路由，整份配置也在读取时被拒绝。
- `invalid_request`：方法缺失或不合法、`target` 不以 `/` 开头、含片段或非法百分号转义。
  只有 JSON 语法损坏才报解析失败，且不猜测哪个字段出错；合法 JSON 但最外层是
  数组、数字、字符串、布尔值或 null 时，reason 说明请求必须是 JSON 对象；合法
  对象中 `method` 或 `target` 写成数字、布尔值、对象、数组或 null 时，reason
  指出该字段必须是字符串并说明收到的类型（null 算类型错误，不是字段未填写），
  两个字段都出错时先报告 `method`，与字段书写顺序无关；空字符串仍是内容问题
  （方法必填、目标路径必须以 `/` 开头），不归为类型错误。
- `route_conflict` / `route_not_found`：见上。

313	func TestInvalidConfigBracketedHostMustBeIPv6(t *testing.T) {
314		// Square brackets mark an IP literal: their content must be a legal IPv6
315		// address. A plain name, a bare IPv4 address, an empty pair or a malformed
316		// IPv6 literal rejects the whole configuration as invalid_config with a
317		// content reason that locates the route by 1-based position, its id and
318		// the upstream field — never as a broken JSON document. The offending
319		// route is rejected even when an earlier route is the one a request hits.
320		badUpstreams := []struct {
321			name     string
322			upstream string
323		}{
324			{"name in brackets", "http://[not-an-ip]/v1"},
325			{"bare ipv4 in brackets", "http://[127.0.0.1]:8080/v1"},
326			{"empty brackets", "http://[]/v1"},
327			{"too many colons", "http://[2001:db8:::1]/v1"},
328			{"non hex group", "http://[gggg::1]/v1"},
329			{"missing closing bracket", "http://[::1/v1"},
330			{"empty percent encoded zone", "http://[fe80::1%25]/v1"},
331			{"future version literal is not plain ipv6", "http://[v1.fe80::]/v1"},
332			{"bad escape in literal", "http://[fe80::1%zz]/v1"},
333		}
334		for _, tc := range badUpstreams {
335			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
336				src := `{"routes":[
337				  {"id":"api","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/api","upstream":"http://api.internal/v1"},
338				  {"id":"admin","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/admin","upstream":"` + tc.upstream + `"}
339				]}`
340				_, f := ParseConfig([]byte(src))
341				if f == nil {
342					t.Fatalf("expected invalid_config for upstream %q", tc.upstream)
343				}
344				if f.Code != "invalid_config" {
345					t.Fatalf("code = %q, want invalid_config", f.Code)
346				}
347				for _, want := range []string{"route 2", `"admin"`, "upstream", "IPv6"} {
348					if !strings.Contains(f.Reason, want) {
349						t.Fatalf("reason = %q, want substring %q", f.Reason, want)
350					}
351				}
352				if strings.Contains(f.Reason, "not valid JSON") {
353					t.Fatalf("a bad bracketed host is a content error, not a JSON syntax failure: %q", f.Reason)
354				}
355			})
356		}
357	
358		// A bracketed host on a later route rejects the config even though the
359		// request only matches the first, valid route.
360		cfg, f := ParseConfig([]byte(`{"routes":[
361		  {"id":"api","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/api","upstream":"http://api.internal/v1"},
362		  {"id":"admin","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/admin","upstream":"http://[not-an-ip]/v1"}
363		]}`))
364		if f == nil {
365			t.Fatal("expected the later route's bracketed-name upstream to reject the config")
366		}
367		if cfg != nil {
368			t.Fatalf("a rejected config must not be returned, got %+v", cfg)
369		}
370	}

736		// Every upstream must carry a genuinely non-empty host. url.Parse itself
737		// accepts a leading port colon with an empty hostname ("http://:8080/base"
738		// parses with Host==":8080" and Hostname()==""), so the rule is enforced
739		// on the raw splitUpstream boundaries: a hostPort that is empty or begins
740		// with the port colon rejects the whole configuration as invalid_config,
741		// whether the missing host leaves just a port, just userinfo or nothing
742		// at all. The reason names the route's 1-based position, its id and the
743		// upstream field and says the upstream is missing a host — it is a content
744		// error in legal JSON, never a JSON parse failure and never an
745		// IPv6-missing-brackets complaint.
746		badUpstreams := []struct {
747			name     string
748			upstream string
749		}{
750			{"bare port under a base path", "http://:8080/base"},
751			{"bare port without a base path", "https://:8443"},
752			{"empty port under a base path", "http://:/base"},
753			{"encoded userinfo before a bare port", "https://user:p%40ss@:8443/v1"},
754			{"plain userinfo before a bare port", "http://user:pass@:8080/base"},
755			{"empty authority before a base path", "http:///base"},
756			{"userinfo reduced to an empty authority", "http://u@/base"},
757			{"userinfo with an empty port and no host", "http://a:b@:/base"},
758		}
759		for _, tc := range badUpstreams {
760			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
761				src := `{"routes":[
762				  {"id":"api","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/api","upstream":"http://api.internal/v1"},
763				  {"id":"admin","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/admin","upstream":"` + tc.upstream + `"}
764				]}`
765				cfg, f := ParseConfig([]byte(src))
766				if f == nil {
767					t.Fatalf("expected invalid_config for upstream %q", tc.upstream)
768				}
769				if f.Code != "invalid_config" {
770					t.Fatalf("code = %q, want invalid_config", f.Code)
771				}
772				for _, want := range []string{"route 2", `"admin"`, "upstream", "missing a host"} {
773					if !strings.Contains(f.Reason, want) {
774						t.Fatalf("reason = %q, want substring %q", f.Reason, want)
775					}
776				}
777				for _, forbidden := range []string{"not valid JSON", "bracket"} {
778					if strings.Contains(f.Reason, forbidden) {
779						t.Fatalf("reason = %q must not say %q: an empty host is an address-content error",
780							f.Reason, forbidden)
781					}
782				}
783				if cfg != nil {
784					t.Fatalf("a rejected config must not be returned, got %+v", cfg)
785				}
786			})
787		}
788	
789		// The offending route may be the only route: validation fails while the
790		// config is read, before any request reaches Resolve.

792			"https://user:p%40ss@:8443/v1"} {

815			t.Fatal("a rejected config must not be returned")
816		}

988	// configFromRoutes builds a config document from raw route objects, so the
989	// same routes can be parsed in different orders.
990	func configFromRoutes(routes ...string) string {
991		return `{"routes":[` + strings.Join(routes, ",") + `]}`

994	func reversed(routes []string) []string {
995		out := make([]string, len(routes))
996		for i, r := range routes {
997			out[len(routes)-1-i] = r
998		}
999		return out
1000	}

1135	func TestResolveConflictOnlyAmongFinalCandidates(t *testing.T) {
1136		// A conflict is reported only when the final candidates cannot be
1137		// narrowed to one: shorter-prefix routes and same-prefix wildcard routes
1138		// are already eliminated and must not appear in the candidate list, and
1139		// no route may be returned as a success.
1140		routes := []string{
1141			`{"id":"z-short","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/a","upstream":"http://short.internal"}`,
1142			`{"id":"wild-long","methods":["*"],"pathPrefix":"/a/b","upstream":"http://wild.internal"}`,
1143			`{"id":"zeta","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/a/b","upstream":"http://z.internal"}`,
1144			`{"id":"alpha","methods":["GET"],"pathPrefix":"/a/b","upstream":"http://a.internal"}`,
1145		}
1146		for _, order := range [][]string{routes, reversed(routes)} {
1147			cfg := mustConfig(t, configFromRoutes(order...))
1148	
1149			res, rf := Resolve(cfg, mustReq(t, "GET", "/a/b/x"))
1150			if res != nil {
1151				t.Fatalf("got success %+v, want route_conflict", res)
1152			}
1153			if rf == nil || rf.Code != "route_conflict" {
1154				t.Fatalf("got %+v, want route_conflict", rf)
1155			}
1156			if want := []string{"alpha", "zeta"}; !equalStrings(rf.Candidates, want) {
1157				t.Fatalf("candidates = %v, want %v (lexicographic, no shorter-prefix or wildcard routes)", rf.Candidates, want)
1158			}
1159	
1160			// The wildcard route at the conflicted prefix still serves methods
1161			// that have no concrete rival there.
1162			res = resolveJSON(t, cfg, `{"method":"POST","target":"/a/b/x"}`)
1163			if res.RouteID != "wild-long" {
1164				t.Fatalf("POST: routeId = %q, want wild-long", res.RouteID)
1165			}
1166	
1167			// The shorter-prefix route still serves requests that never reach
1168			// the conflicted prefix.
1169			res = resolveJSON(t, cfg, `{"method":"GET","target":"/a/other"}`)
1170			if res.RouteID != "z-short" {
1171				t.Fatalf("GET /a/other: routeId = %q, want z-short", res.RouteID)
1172			}
1173		}
1174	}

279	func TestQueryTransformSetInvalidEscapeNoPartialSuccess(t *testing.T) {
280		// A malformed percent escape anywhere in the target fails the whole
281		// request as invalid_request, even when another parameter would have
282		// been replaced by the set rule: no partially rewritten query may come
283		// back as a success.
284		cfg := transformConfig(t, `[{"op":"set","name":"a&b=c","value":"x&y=z"}]`)
285		targets := []string{
286			"/p?a%26b%3dc=1&bad%zz=2", // bad escape after a replaceable parameter
287			"/p?bad%zz=2&a%26b%3dc=1", // bad escape before a replaceable parameter
288			"/p?a%26b%zz=1",           // bad escape inside the target name itself
289			"/p?a%26b%3dc=1%2",        // truncated escape in the replaceable value
290		}
291		for _, target := range targets {
292			// The front door: ParseRequest rejects the target outright.
293			_, rf := ParseRequest([]byte(`{"method":"GET","target":"` + target + `"}`))
294			if rf == nil || rf.Code != "invalid_request" {
295				t.Fatalf("ParseRequest(%q): got %+v, want invalid_request", target, rf)
296			}
297			// A caller that bypasses ParseRequest still gets invalid_request from
298			// Resolve whenever the malformed escape sits in a decoded name, and
299			// never a partial Resolution.
300			res, rf := Resolve(cfg, &Request{Method: "GET", Target: target})
301			if rf != nil && rf.Code != "invalid_request" {
302				t.Fatalf("Resolve(%q): got code %q, want invalid_request", target, rf.Code)
303			}
304			if res != nil && rf != nil {
305				t.Fatalf("Resolve(%q): got both %+v and %+v, want at most one", target, res, rf)
306			}
307		}
308	
309		// A bad escape in a name that the set rule would have replaced is always
310		// caught, even via Resolve directly.
311		for _, target := range []string{"/p?a%26b%zz=1", "/p?bad%zz=2&a%26b%3dc=1"} {
312			res, rf := Resolve(cfg, &Request{Method: "GET", Target: target})
313			if rf == nil || rf.Code != "invalid_request" {
314				t.Fatalf("Resolve(%q): got %+v, want invalid_request", target, rf)
315			}
316			if res != nil {
317				t.Fatalf("Resolve(%q): got partial success %+v, want no resolution", target, res)
318			}
319		}
320	}

497	// TestQueryTransformRenameChain covers consecutive rename rules: every rule
498	// matches the parameter names that exist when that rule runs — the previous
499	// rename's result — never the request's original names and never a single
500	// simultaneous substitution. Renames also never merge or overwrite colliding
501	// names the way set does.
502	func TestQueryTransformRenameChain(t *testing.T) {
503		cases := []struct {
504			name      string
505			rules     string
506			target    string
507			wantQuery string // expected suffix after http://h.internal/base/p
508		}{
509			{
510				// a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4, a -> b then b -> c: after the first rule the
511				// two former a's are b's, so the second rule renames them together
512				// with the request's original b; its original c keeps its place.
513				name:      "second rename follows the first rename result",
514				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
515				target:    "/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4",
516				wantQuery: "?c=1&c=2&c=3&c=4",
517			},
518			{
519				// Same two rules in the opposite order: b -> c runs before a ever
520				// becomes b, so the original b alone moves to c and the a's only
521				// move as far as b. Rule order is observable in the output.
522				name:      "swapping the rules changes which names each rule sees",
523				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"},{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"}]`,
524				target:    "/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4",
525				wantQuery: "?b=1&c=2&b=3&c=4",
526			},
527			{
528				// Three rules forward: every original parameter walks the whole
529				// chain a -> b -> c -> d. A simultaneous rename of the original
530				// names would instead leave three distinct names behind.
531				name:      "three rename rules forward carry every name through",
532				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"},{"op":"rename","name":"c","to":"d"}]`,
533				target:    "/p?a=1&b=2&c=3",
534				wantQuery: "?d=1&d=2&d=3",
535			},
536			{
537				// The same three rules in reverse move each name exactly one
538				// step: c -> d runs before b -> c, which runs before a -> b.
539				name:      "three rename rules in reverse move names one step each",
540				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"c","to":"d"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"},{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"}]`,
541				target:    "/p?a=1&b=2&c=3",
542				wantQuery: "?b=1&c=2&d=3",
543			},
544			{
545				// Names collide on both hops, including duplicate target-name
546				// parameters: nothing merges or overwrites. Five parameters enter
547				// and five leave, each keeping its position, value and order.
548				name:      "colliding renames keep every parameter in place without merging",
549				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
550				target:    "/p?b=9&a=1&b=8&a=2&c=0",
551				wantQuery: "?c=9&c=1&c=8&c=2&c=0",
552			},
553			{
554				// Only each hit's name changes: value bytes (lowercase escapes,
555				// '+', extra '='), the valueless form and the empty value's '='
556				// all survive both renames, as do non-hit parameters.
557				name:      "chained renames keep value bytes and both empty forms",
558				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
559				target:    "/p?a=%2f+%2F+a=b&a&a=&x=1",
560				wantQuery: "?c=%2f+%2F+a=b&c&c=&x=1",
561			},
562			{
563				// Empty fragments and non-hit parameters keep their bytes and
564				// positions while the hits walk both rules.
565				name:      "chained renames leave empty fragments and misses as is",
566				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
567				target:    "/p?z=0&&a=1&&b=2&",
568				wantQuery: "?z=0&&c=1&&c=2&",
569			},
570			{
571				// A first rule with no source changes nothing and must not
572				// re-encode existing names (the raw '+' stays a '+'), and later
573				// rules still run: a walks to b and then c while "a b" never
574				// matches a rule looking for "a".
575				name:      "a no-hit rule neither re-encodes nor stops later rules",
576				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"z","to":"q"},{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
577				target:    "/p?a=1&a+b=2&a%20b=3",
578				wantQuery: "?c=1&a+b=2&a%20b=3",
579			},
580			{
581				// A rule renaming a name to itself is a byte-for-byte no-op (no
582				// re-encoding of either space spelling) and must not break the
583				// chain: the later rules still run on their results.
584				name:      "a self-rename step neither re-encodes nor stops later rules",
585				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a b","to":"a b"},{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
586				target:    "/p?a=1&a+b=2&a%20b=3",
587				wantQuery: "?c=1&a+b=2&a%20b=3",
588			},
589			{
590				name:      "chained renames with no query string do not create a mark",
591				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
592				target:    "/p",
593				wantQuery: "",
594			},
595			{
596				name:      "chained renames with an empty question mark keep it",
597				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
598				target:    "/p?",
599				wantQuery: "?",
600			},
601		}
602		for _, tc := range cases {
603			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
604				got := transformResult(t, tc.rules, tc.target)
605				want := buildWant(tc.target, tc.wantQuery)
606				if got != want {
607					t.Errorf("upstreamURL = %q, want %q", got, want)
608				}
609			})
610		}

647				// request's p%2Bq; the request's raw p+q (a space name) does not

668				rules:     `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"B"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`,
669				target:    "/p?a=1&b=2&B=3",
670				wantQuery: "?B=1&c=2&B=3",
671			},
672		}
673		for _, tc := range cases {
674			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
675				got := transformResult(t, tc.rules, tc.target)

684	// TestQueryTransformRenameChainInvalidEscapeStillRejected pins that a rename
685	// chain can never launder a malformed percent escape into an accepted request:
686	// all names are decoded before any rule runs, so renaming the carrying
687	// parameter later cannot make the request valid, and no partially chained query
688	// may come back as a success.
689	func TestQueryTransformRenameChainInvalidEscapeStillRejected(t *testing.T) {
690		cfg := transformConfig(t, `[{"op":"rename","name":"a","to":"b"},{"op":"rename","name":"b","to":"c"}]`)
691		targets := []string{
692			"/p?a=1&b%zz=2",     // rule two would rename the bad name away

## 新增文件

**`contractsentinel/config_error_precedence_test.go`**（包内，24 个子用例）

- `TestFieldTypeErrorsBeatRuleErrors` — 核心场景：第一条路由 queryTransforms 未知 op，第二条路由 `methods` 写成字符串，返回的原因指向第二条的 `methods` 而非第一条规则；id `"orders"` 写在 methods 之后仍被带上；同一对象字段三种书写顺序结果一致；另覆盖 pathPrefix/upstream 类型错误、methods 非字符串元素、null 路由元素、多类型错误取数组最早、id 自身类型错误只按位置定位。
- `TestRuleErrorsBeatFieldContentErrors` — 基础字段类型修正后，非法规则成为原因，带从 1 开始的路由序号与规则序号；较早路由的 pathPrefix 不以 `/` 开头、非法 method token、空 id、错误 scheme 等内容错误，都让位于较后路由的非法规则。
- `TestRuleErrorEarliestByArrayPosition` — 多路由规则都非法时报数组最早的路由（`zzz` 先于字典序更早的 `aaa`）；跨路由时早路由的第 3 条规则压过晚路由的第 1 条；同一路由报规则数组最早的一条。
- `TestRepairingOneLayerRevealsTheNext` — 同一份文档逐层修正：类型错误 → 规则错误 → 内容错误 → 被接受；全修正后验证路由段边界选择、上游路径拼接、set/remove/rename 三条规则按序改写，无规则路由的原始查询串（含重复参数）逐字节保留。
- `TestBrokenConfigJSONGuessesNothing` — JSON 语法损坏（含开头有完整路由）只报解析失败，不猜字段/路由/规则位置。
- 所有失败断言 `ParseConfig` 返回的 cfg 为 nil，杜绝半份配置。

**`cmd/contractsentinel/resolve_precedence_cli_test.go`**（CLI 端到端，4 个测试）
以用户视角固定：非零退出、失败时 stdout 完全空白、stderr 恰好一个 JSON、`invalid_config` 与原因；并覆盖逐层修正后完整 resolve 成功，以及字段顺序无关、数组位置选择、语法损坏不猜位置。
